question: A generator is a device that converts:
solution:
The correct answer is __**mechanical energy to electrical energy**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A generator is a device that converts mechanical energy into electrical energy.
 
• A generator uses mechanical energy from an external source to produce electrical energy.
 
• The mechanical energy is used to rotate a turbine, which produces electricity
 
• Generators work based on the principle of electromagnetic induction, which is when a changing magnetic field induces a voltage
 
• A motor does the opposite of a generator, converting electrical energy into mechanical energy

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Electrical energy to heat energy:** This is the function of a heater or resistor, not a generator.
 
• **Heat energy to mechanical energy:** This is the principle behind a heat engine, like a steam engine or internal combustion engine, not a generator.
 
• **Electrical energy to mechanical energy:** This is the function of a motor, which is the opposite of a generator.
 
 
• Motors convert electrical energy into mechanical energy.
